cues: 몸 형태 quadruped → 눈 간격 눈 사이가 넓은

prompt:
INPUT: attach this character's mobility-form card image (the closed state). If a second image fits, add her approved light-form image for the face.

SOURCE: Stantler (노라키), normal type.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

OUTPUT: the OPENED (overdrive) state of the attached image. Keep its camera, pose, framing, subject scale, face, hair, body and every armor piece exactly. Change only this: the fanned panels spread further and their thruster covers open, revealing the inner frame, and a warm white-gold light shows through the gaps, lighting the undersides of the opened plates; her eyes keep their color with only a glint of that light, and her expression tightens with the strain. No new armor, no new helmet, no weapon. The pair must read as the same picture before and after she opens up.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

HANDS: keep both hands exactly as in the attached image — one thumb and four fingers each, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra; the glow and spray stay off the fingers.
origin: actual UI selected; repository engine reproduces inspected UI output
